Generative_KI: In this work, we investigate the possibilities of using LLMs in a resume screening setting via a document retrieval framework that simulates job candidate selection.
Prompting: In document retrieval with MTEs, query texts are encoded with an additional instruction describing the particular setting.
KI_Sonstige: Artificial intelligence (AI) hiring tools have revolutionized resume screening, and large language models (LLMs) have the potential to do the same.
Bias_Ungleichheit: We find that the MTEs are biased, significantly favoring White-associated names in 85.1% of cases and female-associated names in only 11.1% of cases, with a minority of cases showing no statistically significant differences.
Gender: In 51.9% of 27 tests for gender bias in resume screening, male names were preferred to female names, and only in 11.1% of tests were female names preferred, as seen in Figure 5.
Feministisch: Furthermore, the results correspond to three additional hypotheses from Ghavami and Peplau (2013) regarding intersectionality.

According to Drage and Mackereth (2022), addressing and solving inequities in resume screening mediated by AI or LLMs requires accounting for structural power imbalances that underpin the conceptualization and use of these tools.
Fairness: In all experiments, the initial pools of resumes are balanced with respect to identity groups, and the expected outcome is that all groups should be represented uniformly if the MTEs are unbiased.

Therefore, policy and mechanisms to comprehensively audit resume screening systems, whether proprietary or open source, are essential in order to evaluate their fairness and improve or remove these systems accordingly.

analysis.AN_Notes: Resume audit of three Massive Text Embedding models (Mistral-7B based) as retrieval-based resume screening over nine occupations with names associated with Black and White women and men. AN_Task Other_Task: resume screening in hiring. Prompting role Research_Instrument for the task instructions encoded with the job descriptions, no codable technique.
